node: Defense prime contractors and program integrators
summary: This Layer 1B pass maps direct public-company exposure to the defense-prime and program-integrator node. The reference lane is anchored by large primes that convert appropriations into long-cycle procurement pull-through and set supplier qualification requirements. The discovery lane emphasizes smaller or less-index-dominant public integrators/prime-adjacent firms where exposure to Navy shipbuilding, cyber, EW, mission systems, or government IT may be more specific but still needs program-level validation. External evidence supports the broader chokepoint: tariffs have been muted for major primes due to national-security exemptions, while smaller lower-tier suppliers face higher administrative burdens and weaker supply-chain visibility.
